graph.n: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
graph.m: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
graph.target_density: <float> Intended probability that any two vertices are connected by an edge.
graph.actual_density: <float> Realized fraction of possible edges that are present in the graph.
graph.edges: <list[list[int]], length m> Each entry is a pair [u, v] identifying two vertices connected by an edge, with u < v.
graph.adjacency_list: <list[list[int]], shape [n]> For each vertex, the sorted list of neighboring vertices that share an edge with it.
